description: This file defines the implementation of the DohProviderEntry class, including static methods for retrieving a list of DoH providers, constructing test instances, and the class constructor. It manages DoH provider configurations, including IP addresses, hostnames, and server templates, with features and privacy policies.

classes.name: DohProviderEntry
classes.description: Represents a DNS-over-HTTPS provider configuration, including IP addresses, hostnames, server templates, and associated features and policies.

methods.name: DohProviderEntry::GetList
methods.description: Returns a static list of predefined DoH provider entries.

methods.name: DohProviderEntry::ConstructForTesting
methods.description: Creates a DohProviderEntry instance for testing purposes with specified parameters.

methods.name: DohProviderEntry::DohProviderEntry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a provider entry with given configuration parameters.
